# About this book {.unnumbered}

This ebook is my working record for the course *Advanced Data Wrangling and Reproducible Workflows*.
Each chapter is one part of the course.

**Author:** *(your name, programme)*

**What I hope to learn:** *(two or three sentences)*

::: {.callout-tip}
## How this book works
- Each chapter starts with a **Data source** box (where the data came from, licence, date).
- Raw data live in `data/raw/` and are committed to the repository.
- Chapters read only from saved files. They never call an API while rendering.
:::
